Class Lang

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Lang
public final class Lang extends Object
The language of the plugins' texts. Every text a player sees is a translation key, in each plugin's Server/Languages/<locale>/server.lang under the plugin's id ("server.coins.pay.sent"; item names stay in items.lang). The game sends each player the texts in the language their game is set to, and English for any key a language does not have.

The admin can choose one language for all these plugins on the General tab of /tempest, for languages the game itself does not offer yet (German, Polish). The plugins' texts are then swapped for that language's on their way to every player; the game's own texts stay in the player's language.

Admins can also reword any of the plugins' texts in /tempest texts, for one language or all; those are laid over the plugins' own texts the same way.
